articles.title: Show HN: Squeezed – Pipe any audio into synced Squeezebox players, no LMS needed
articles.summary: Squeezed is a technical application designed to stream raw PCM S16LE audio to Squeezelite and Squeezebox clients using the SlimProto protocol. It supports diverse input methods, including standard input, FIFOs, Unix sockets, and TCP sockets. This software facilitates efficient digital audio distribution over a network to compatible devices, showcasing advancements in audio networking technology, relevant for specialized media setups or home entertainment systems.
